import awkward as ak
from pocket_coffea.lib.categorization import MultiCut, CartesianCut

# Multi-bin cut wrapper for jet multiplicity (JetGood)
jet_multiplicity = MultiCut(
    name="jet_multiplicity",
    cuts={
        "exactly_4j": lambda events: ak.num(events.JetGood, axis=1) == 4,
        "exactly_5j": lambda events: ak.num(events.JetGood, axis=1) == 5,
        "atleast_6j": lambda events: ak.num(events.JetGood, axis=1) >= 6,
    }
)

# Multi-bin cut wrapper for b-tag multiplicity
btag_multiplicity = MultiCut(
    name="btag_multiplicity",
    cuts={
        "exactly_2b": lambda events: ak.num(events.BTagGood, axis=1) == 2,
        "atleast_3b": lambda events: ak.num(events.BTagGood, axis=1) >= 3,
    }
)

# Cartesian combination container
analysis_categories = CartesianCut(
    cuts=[jet_multiplicity, btag_multiplicity]
)
